defects: Quantity shortfall: 60 EACH invoiced, only 52 EACH received (8 kits refused as damaged at dock) — clause 4 under-delivery
rationale: Receipt GR-7724 shows 52 of 60 EACH received (8 refused damaged), so under clause 4 the payable is computed on the received quantity: 52 x $320.00 = $16,640.00. Unit price matches the PO exactly (clause 3). Tax recomputed at the vendor's 7.5% on the corrected net gives $1,248.00, total $17,888.00; the supplier's $1,440.00 is simply 7.5% of the overstated net, so it is a consequence of the quantity shortfall and not a separate tax-rate defect. One defect only, so no clause 11 escalation; $17,888.00 falls in the AP_MANAGER band (clause 10).
